newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 2c to 567c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 2c to 567c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell by two cents to 567 cents a kg clean at sales in Goulburn and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19/20 micron indicators up to 1.0 percent cheaper.
The 21/22m categories were 0.5 percent cheaper while 23/24/26m were 0.5 percent dearer and 25m 1.0 percent dearer, WI said. Merino skirtings were unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28/30m were 0.5 percent dearer, 29m was 1.0 percent dearer and 31m slightly dearer, it said.
In cardings, lambs were slightly cheaper, locks unchanged and crutchings 1.5 percent dearer.
WI said Japanese, Chinese and Western European interests were principal buyers with support from Taiwan.
Of the 25,164 bales offered in both centres, 5.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 101,521 bales to be offered.
